allocation_rule: Ringfence universal entitlement, separately account restitution, investment and administration; do not automatically convert MOIRA carbon restitution into UBI
financing_requirements: Realized incremental AI-era value attributable to capital/labor substitution and platform rents
Public equity returns or licensing revenue
Enforceable levy/tax on actual realized gains
Avoid double-counting corporate profits and underlying productivity value
Include price and wage response, labor supply effects, company relocation and tax avoidance
Disability, healthcare and elder benefits independent
governance: Digital ledger calculation does not itself create revenue, legal entitlement or transfer authority.
limitations: No demonstrated funding sufficiency; $2k is a chosen adequacy target, not a measured living wage across all regions.
next: Determine real public receipts and feasible sources, preserve separate restitution from universal dividend
